title: [GAME THEORY] The Help Desk Is Becoming the New Intrusion Broker
content_md: The phone call is the lure. The product is authority. AlphaHunt examines how vishing crews exploit the incentive gap between fast support and safe identity decisions. The analysis separates help-desk recovery, AiTM session theft, and malicious OAuth consent; maps the moves and countermoves; and shows where defenders can break the trust-conversion path without turning every support request into a tribunal. Read the full analysis here .
exclude_reason: Generic analysis/opinion piece on vishing tactics; no specific CVEs, incidents, or actionable intelligence. More editorial than event coverage.
